notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a non-Human you control with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then also enter with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.name: Dominion Saboteur
uses.cardState: without a +1/+1 counter on it and not copying a Human
